title: Projectvoorbereider Paneelbouw
description:
Geen project is hetzelfde. Jij zorgt ervoor dat alles klopt voordat de productie start en houdt ook tijdens de uitvoering zicht op de voortgang.

Je bekijkt ieder project vanuit een technisch, organisatorisch én financieel perspectief. Je maakt calculaties, zorgt voor een goede materiaalvoorziening, bewaakt levertijden en onderhoudt contact met leveranciers. Met een goede planning en duidelijke technische voorbereiding zorg je ervoor dat jouw collega’s in de productie aan de slag kunnen.

Ook daarna blijf je betrokken. Je volgt de voortgang, bewaakt de kosten en het materiaalbudget en signaleert tijdig meer- en minderwerk. Loop je tegen een technisch knelpunt aan? Dan zoek je samen met je collega’s naar een praktische oplossing. Zie je mogelijkheden om iets slimmer, beter of efficiënter te doen? Dan krijg je de ruimte om daarin mee te denken.

Goed samenwerken is daarin belangrijk. Je schakelt met de Projectleider en monteurs en onderhoudt contact met klanten en leveranciers over de voortgang van het project.


Kortom: een veelzijdige functie waarin techniek, organiseren en samenwerken samenkomen en waarin jij écht invloed hebt op het verloop van onze projecten.



Het belangrijkste is dat je enthousiast wordt van techniek, graag overzicht houdt, organisatorisch sterk bent en het leuk vindt om samen met anderen projecten tot een goed resultaat te brengen.


Daarnaast herken jij jezelf waarschijnlijk in het volgende:

  • Je hebt minimaal mbo+ werk- en denkniveau;
  • Je hebt affiniteit met techniek, paneelbouw en/of elektronica;
  • Je werkt nauwkeurig en houdt graag overzicht;
  • Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor je eigen werk;
  • Je denkt vooruit en ziet kansen om zaken slimmer of beter aan te pakken;
  • Je werkt graag samen en schakelt gemakkelijk met collega’s, klanten en leveranciers;
  • Je staat open om te leren en jezelf verder te ontwikkelen.


Je werkt bij een van de grootste internationale spelers in de industrie: Actemium, een merk van VINCI Energies. De kansen om de industrie én jezelf uit te dagen liggen voor het oprapen. Ondernemen, verantwoordelijkheid en projecten met serieuze impact: bij ons vind je het allemaal. Kijk maar eens op wat we allemaal doen!


Tegelijkertijd voelt de organisatie heel lokaal aan. Hoe dat komt? Door onze 25 zelfstandige businessunits verspreid over Nederland. De businessunit is de thuisbasis voor onze collega's. Een plek met een sterk teamgevoel, waar geluisterd wordt naar ideeën en waar iedereen elkaar persoonlijk kent.


Deze businessunit in Veghel is specialist in panelenbouw. Samen met een team van zo’n 55 collega’s werken we voor innovatieve machinebouwers en industriële automatiseerders, waarbij onze producten internationaal worden ingezet. Als verlengstuk van onze klanten ontzorgen wij op het gebied van paneelbouw, waarbij projectmatige vraagstukken worden omgezet tot modulaire bouwstenen. Bij ons is het altijd uitdagend werk. Samen zijn wij ambitieus en nemen wij onze verantwoordelijkheden. Daarbij hechten wij enorm veel waarde aan persoonlijke ontwikkeling en zetten wij iedereen in op zijn of haar kracht.


Reageer direct

Kies voor ‘direct solliciteren’ als je meteen je cv en motivatie wilt doorgeven. Liever eerst in gesprek over de mogelijkheden voor jou? Kies dan ‘eerst een kopje koffie’. In dat geval bellen we je om een afspraak te plannen. Tot snel!

We bieden je naast een goed salaris een heel mooi pakket aan arbeidsvoorwaarden, opleidingsmogelijkheden en loopbaankansen. Daar vertellen we je graag alles over in een persoonlijk gesprek. Alvast een sneak preview:


· Een goed salaris passend bij jouw kennis en ervaring (€ 3.082,17 tot € 5.233,82);

· Afhankelijk van bedrijfsresultaat een winstuitkering;

· Vrijheid om je werktijden, binnen de gemaakte afspraken, flexibel in te delen;

· 25 vakantiedagen en 13 ADV-dagen volgens de cao Metaal & Techniek;

· Een goede pensioenregeling en collectieve verzekeringen;

· Een aantrekkelijk aandelenspaarplan met gratis bonusaandelen (onder voorwaarden);

· Volop ontwikkel- en doorgroeimogelijkheden binnen Actemium en VINCI Energies;

· Mogelijkheden om met korting te sporten;

· Toegang tot meer dan 100 online trainingen via GoodHabitz.

title: Traffic Technician, Entry Level
description:
Location: Saskatoon, SK

Employment Status: Day shift 8:00AM -4:30PM On-call availability and Weekend work as well.

About ATS Traffic

ATS Traffic is a family-owned business that has been getting people home safely since 1966. We provide traffic control, on-street services and signage products and services across Canada, currently operating out of offices in Edmonton, Calgary, Regina, Saskatoon, Langley, Kamloops and Winnipeg. As the successful candidate you will demonstrate the ATS Traffic Core Values at work every day:

  • Do What’s Right
  • Our People Matter
  • Trust Through Teamwork
  • Striving for Excellence

About the Positions

ATS Traffic Saskatoon is recruiting for Traffic Control People (also known as TCP's or Traffic Technicians) for the 2026 season! You will be responsible for implementing protected Work Areas for contractors and the like, within Saskatoon and Saskatchewan. TCP's implement safe lane closures and traffic detours with physical setup and removal of devices such as barricades, pylons, signage and digital messaging boards.

Qualifications

  • A year of previous traffic control experience will be considered an asset, specifically lane closures and takedowns.
  • A valid Non-GDL (non-graduated) Class 5 Driver’s License and a Clean 3-Year Regular Drivers Abstract is required to drive our company vehicles.
  • Experience with Flat Deck trucks and Towing trailers an asset.
  • Navigation of City of Saskatoon an Asset
  • Own vehicle to get to and from work is required as ATS is not located on public transit routes.
  • As this is a safety-sensitive role, all candidates must undergo and pass a pre-employment Drug and Alcohol Test. Note: All safety-sensitive positions have a zero tolerance policy marijuana, medical or recreational.
  • Ability to successfully pass a Fit Test including lifting between 50 to 75 pounds.
  • A valid ACSA TCP Ticket is an asset, however ATS covers the cost and provides ALL training and tickets to get you started!
  • Personal Protective Equipment (PPE): All you need to bring is a pair of CSA Approved Safety Boots on your first day - we will cover the rest.

Why ATS Traffic?

We have always been a family-owned business. When you join ATS, you aren’t just a number: people know your name and treat you like one of the family! Other perks include:

  • Competitive wages and opportunities for overtime.
  • Opportunities for on-the-job training, equipment operation, and career growth.
  • Work with a team-oriented, safety-first company.
  • Consistent work in a high-demand industry with room to grow.
  • Potential for rehire and promotion within the company.

Do you have a good attitude? Do you do whatever it takes to get the job done? If this sounds like you, we think you’d be a great fit at ATS Traffic – apply today!

Maintains flexibility in schedule and responds to unexpected participant care needs and changes in workload and location of work as directed.

  • Performs and/or assists the participant/family with home maintenance activities according to Plan of Care including but not limited to light housekeeping and meal preparation.

Care Synergy is a network of mission driven, nonprofit healthcare organizations dedicated to caring for very ill, frail, and primarily elderly individuals by keeping them at home and out of the hospital while maximizing comfort, dignity, and quality of life.

The Care Synergy enterprise includes a group of collaborating nonprofit Affiliates across Colorado’s Front Range that share resources, expertise, and infrastructure to deliver high quality, compassionate care. Across the Care Synergy network, the organizations provide significant community impact, including more than 7,000 hospice patients served annually, more than 2,000 palliative care patients, more than 355,000 hospice days of care each year, and more than $1.6 million in charitable care provided annually.

title: CLINICAL INTERN
description:
✨ Join a team of passionate advocates on our mission to improve the lives of youth! Rite of Passage is seeking Clinical Interns enrolled in Master of Social Work (MSW), Clinical Mental Health Counseling, or related graduate counseling programs at our Arkansas juvenile treatment facilities! ✨

At Rite of Passage, we are committed to helping youth build brighter futures through structure, accountability, education, and individualized treatment. Our Arkansas programs serve court-involved youth in the custody of the Arkansas Division of Youth Services (DYS). We provide a structured, therapeutic environment focused on personal growth, emotional development, behavioral change, and successful rehabilitation.

We are seeking motivated graduate students who want to gain practical clinical experience while working alongside experienced professionals in a multidisciplinary treatment setting. This internship offers an opportunity to apply classroom knowledge to real-world clinical practice while developing the skills needed for a career in social work, counseling, and behavioral health.

As a Clinical Intern, you will have the opportunity to:

  • Work with a small caseload of youth under appropriate clinical supervision.
  • Participate in therapeutic groups and assist with group facilitation and skill-building activities.
  • Assist with developing, reviewing, and updating individualized treatment plans.
  • Attend multidisciplinary treatment team meetings and collaborate with clinical, educational, medical, and residential staff.
  • Assist with clinical documentation, progress notes, treatment reviews, and monitoring progress toward treatment goals.
  • Gain experience supporting youth with trauma histories, emotional regulation difficulties, behavioral challenges, substance use concerns, and other mental health needs.
  • Develop professional skills in therapeutic communication, ethical practice, case conceptualization, and trauma-informed care.

To be considered, you should:

  • Be currently enrolled in a Master of Social Work, Clinical Mental Health Counseling, or related graduate program.
  • Be seeking a clinical internship or practicum placement that aligns with your university's requirements.
  • Demonstrate professionalism, dependability, compassion, and a willingness to learn.
  • Be comfortable working with court-involved youth in a structured juvenile justice treatment environment.
  • Meet applicable facility, background screening, and university placement requirements.

Schedule: Flexible weekday scheduling, Monday through Friday, between 8:00 a.m. and 5:00 p.m. Specific hours will be coordinated based on university requirements, site needs, and clinical supervision availability.

Internship Placement: Lewisville Juvenile Treatment Center (LJTC) located in Lewisville, AR.

Make a Difference While Building Your Future!

This is an opportunity to gain meaningful clinical experience, strengthen your professional identity, and contribute to the treatment and rehabilitation of youth who need guidance, support, and opportunities for change. If you are passionate about helping young people develop healthier coping skills, improve decision-making, and work toward a more successful future, we encourage you to explore an internship with Rite of Passage.

After more than 40 years of improving the lives of youth, Rite of Passage continues to seek passionate individuals who believe in the power of growth, accountability, and second chances.

Apply today and take the next step in your clinical career!

ZOSTAŃ PARTNEREM /PARTNERKĄ STACJI PALIW I ROZWIŃ SWÓJ BIZNES Z CIRCLE K!


Kim jesteśmy?

Circle K to międzynarodowa marka stacji paliw, obecna w Polsce od 1992 roku. Sieć obejmuje flagowe stacje własne, stacje segmentu ekonomicznego oraz stacje franczyzowe. Naszym celem jest tworzenie stabilnych warunków do rozwoju lokalnego biznesu.

Nasze wymagania/oczekiwania:

  • Gotowość do prowadzenia własnej działalności gospodarczej i osobistego zarządzania stacją paliw w oparciu o umowę B2B zawartą z Circle K Polska Sp. z o.o.

  • Umiejętności analityczne, znajomość pakietu MS Office i koncentracja na osiąganie wyników

  • Współpraca z Circle K w realizacji celów biznesowych oraz rozwijaniu oferty dostosowanej do lokalnego rynku
  • Odpowiedzialność za wdrażanie nowych produktów, utrzymanie estetyki i porządku na stacji oraz nadzór nad prawidłowym funkcjonowaniem gospodarki magazynowej.

title: Assistant Property Manager
description:
Company Overview

Avenue Living Residential is Western Canada's fastest-growing private rental properties operator, with an expanding presence in Alberta, Saskatchewan, and Manitoba.

We believe in bringing people together and building relationships we are proud of every day. Our core values guide our actions, and our people bring our mission to life. We are committed to providing safe and welcoming accommodations while being responsive to our residents’ needs with efficient execution.

Our innovative teams work together to deliver both quality and value to our residents as we pride ourselves in creating communities that are safe and comfortable place to call home.

What We Are About

At Avenue Living Residential, we ensure our team members are provided with a place to develop careers that are challenging and rewarding so everyone can realize their full potential. We know our people are our biggest brand ambassadors and create our culture. We believe when we take care of our team members, they can then extend that Duty of Care to our residents and business partners.

We look for team members who are collaborative, creative, and In It Together. Individuals who are accountable, consistent, resourceful, and responsive. Those who can take initiative, seek feedback and demonstrate grit in overcoming challenges and adapting to change.

Green Is More Than Just Our Colour

If you are wondering if the grass is greener here at Avenue Living Residential, you can take comfort in knowing that through our common purpose we build relationships we are proud of every day.

By focusing on leadership excellence, employee engagement, and quality service- combined with a continuous improvement mindset, we give you the green light to create meaningful connections and memorable experiences. Fostering a positive environment where people feel energized and empowered to have sustainable results

In addition to our team members, we also want our planet to thrive. Avenue Living Residential is committed to a green future by enhancing our properties with features such as environmentally friendly water management procedures, improved heating and cooling systems, solar panels, and upgraded air filtration technology.

WHAT WILL YOU DO?

  • Participate in the full leasing process by ensuring your calendar is effectively managed and that all leads, showings, applications, and leases are followed up on and actioned in a timely manner.
  • Complete renewal activities by ensuring eligible residents receive renewal offers 90 days in advance, renewals are actively followed up on to ensure they are signed 30 days in advance of lease expiry, and that all renewal documentation is uploaded, revised, and accurate.
  • Support all collection efforts by ensuring residents are notified of any payment issues, notice documents are promptly served, residents are consistently followed up on, and payment issues are resolved as quickly as possible.
  • Assist the Residential Portfolio Manager in maintaining portfolio inventory levels to ensure availability of all suite types by conducting suite assessments in advance of move-outs, planning and submitting approval requests for suite turns, issuing purchase orders to vendors and/or work orders to maintenance associates, following up after the work is complete to ensure quality standards are met, and completing all documentation and Yardi entries to ensure all stages of the suite turn life cycle are current and up to date.
  • Assist the Residential Portfolio Manager in ensuring all maintenance and repairs are conducted in a safe, timely, and cost-efficient manner by actively reviewing all resident inquiries and work order reports, scheduling repairs with maintenance associates and/or vendors, issuing purchase orders as required, following up after the work is complete to ensure quality standards are met, and completing all documentation and Yardi entries to ensure all stages of the work order life cycle are current and up to date.
  • Assist in maintaining properties by investigating and resolving resident complaints, enforcing rules of occupancy, and by regularly inspecting buildings and vacant units.
  • Complete move-in inspections with resident(s) and ensure all required documentation is uploaded to Yardi within 24 hours.
  • Assist with move-out inspections with resident(s) and ensure all required documentation is uploaded to Yardi within 24 hours.
  • Working closely and supporting the Residential Portfolio Manager in the management and maintenance of the operating budgets.
  • Create a best-in-class customer experience by providing prompt and courteous service to prospective and current residents.
  • Support and assist community engagement through building relationships among local businesses, schools and community groups and developing ways to best market these communities.
  • Other duties as required.

      WHAT WILL YOU NEED?

      • Previous property management experience would be an asset.
      • Financial acumen, specifically with budget management.
      • Must possess a valid driver's license and access to a reliable vehicle.
      • Must have a clean driver’s abstract.
      • Must complete & pass a criminal record check.

            WHAT DO WE OFFER?

            • We live and breathe our core values. We go the extra mile. We’re honest. We always have each other's back. We have tons of integrity. And we always own it and adapt – no matter the challenge.
            • With the support to do things differently, grow personally and professionally and bring your whole self to work, there's no limit to the impact you can make.
            • We provide a competitive compensation package comprised of a group benefits plan, GRSP Matching Program, and discretionary bonus program for select roles. In addition, Avenue Living also offers an Employee Referral Program that rewards active employees for successful referrals.
            • An employee centric culture with a generous award and recognition program, discounted monthly rent in Avenue Living Residential properties, and an employee discount and savings program through industry partnerships and Perkopolis.
            • We are committed to a strong safe work environment.

            What makes us different makes us stronger. We want Avenue Living to be a great place to work for everyone; where people feel safe, included, inspired, trusted and supported so they can be, and bring, their best.

            We’re committed to creating a respectful and inclusive workplace where unique perspectives, experiences, backgrounds, cultures and attributes are valued and utilized to help achieve better results. As an organization with operations across different geographies, we celebrate the fact that our workforce is made up of people with diverse demographics.

            We are committed to ensuring our workplace is fair, equitable and free of discrimination and harassment.

title: Senior Analyst, Cybersecurity Operations & Response
description:
As a member of the Information Services Department, the Senior Analyst, Cybersecurity Operations & Response supports the execution and continuous improvement of the Firm’s Cybersecurity Operations & Response program. This role is responsible for assisting with security operations, incident response activities, and threat and vulnerability management initiatives to help protect the Firm’s systems, applications, and data from cyber threats.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

· Support the day-to-day operation and execution of the Firm’s Cybersecurity Operations & Response program.

· Assist with the administration and continuous improvement of the Firm’s threat and vulnerability management program.

· Develop, maintain, and update associated playbooks, policies, standards, and procedural documentation.

· Participate in cyber event response activities, including investigation, containment, remediation, and recovery efforts.

· Serve as a primary resource for security operations monitoring and incident triage activities.

· Perform threat and vulnerability assessments and assist with remediation efforts to ensure systems are protected from known and potential threats.

· Monitor security tools and alerts to identify, analyze, and escalate potential security incidents.

· Develop and distribute reporting and metrics related to security operations, incidents, vulnerabilities, and overall program effectiveness.

· Collaborate with internal teams and third-party providers to support security initiatives and operational improvements.

· Participate in an on-call rotation and be available to respond to cybersecurity incidents and operational issues outside of normal business hours, as needed.

ADDITIONAL FUNCTIONS:

· Additional duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS (EXPERIENCE, KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES):

Education:

· Bachelor’s degree in information security or an equivalent combination of work and education required.

Experience:

· Minimum of five years of information security experience required including some direct experience with security operations, incident response, and threat/vulnerability management.

Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities:

· Knowledge of information security principles, including security operations, incident response, and threat and vulnerability management.

· Knowledge of NIST and MITRE ATT&CK frameworks.

· Experience in developing, documenting, and maintaining security procedures including security response playbooks.

· Experience in developing, managing, and executing a threat and vulnerability management program.

· Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to enable effective security event and problem resolution.

· Ability to work well under minimal supervision.

· Strong written and verbal communication skills.

· Strong customer/client focus, with the ability to manage expectations appropriately, provide a superior customer/client experience, and build long-term relationships.

WORK ENVIRONMENT & PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

This job operates in a clerical, office setting. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, filing cabinets and fax machines.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

Sedentary work: Exertion of physical strength to lift, carry, push, pull, or otherwise move objects up to 10 pounds. Work involves sitting most of the time. Walking and standing is often necessary in carrying out job duties.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

The salary ranges for this position apply to the respective listed locations. The salary range reflects a variety of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions, including but not limited to experience, education, licensure and/or certifications, geographic location, market demands and other business and organizational needs. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for a position. Reasonable estimates of the current ranges for this position are:

  • Las Vegas: $100,000 - $115,000
  • Atlantic City, Chicago, Minneapolis: $110,000 - $125,000
  • Boston, Denver, Los Angeles, Morristown, Princeton, Seattle, Washington, D.C.: $115,000 - $130,000
  • New York & San Francisco: $140,000 - $155,000

title: Retail Customer Experience Associate, Bellevue Square - Full Time
description:
Be Part of an Amazing Story

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

Job Overview

As a Customer Experience Colleague, you will create exceptional, personalized shopping experiences for our customers. You’ll prioritize customer satisfaction by actively engaging with shoppers across all touchpoints - both in-store and online - and drive cross-category sales to support overall business goals. With a deep understanding of fashion, fit, and function, you will make tailored product recommendations and leverage digital tools to enhance the customer journey. You also will work across different departments daily, often transitioning between multiple areas throughout the day.

In this role, you’ll also play a key part in client relationship building through outreach tools like My Client and social media. Your collaborative approach with peers, store leaders, and brand partners will help identify opportunities, resolve challenges, and elevate the overall customer experience. In addition to service and selling, you’ll support operational excellence through floor readiness, event execution, merchandise setup, and opening/closing procedures.

A positive, can-do attitude, strong communication skills, and a passion for delivering high-caliber service will be key to your success in this role.

How Our Selling Colleagues Spend Their Day…

  • Our colleagues begin each day energized and ready to make an impact. They wear their name badge with pride, greet teammates with a warm hello, and help ensure the sales floor is clean, organized, and prepared for customers. Before getting started, they review their sales goals, learn about new arrivals and top-selling items, and stay up to date on current trends and promotions - so they’re fully informed and ready to engage, educate, and sell with confidence.
  • On the floor, they focus on the customer - offering a warm welcome, making eye contact, and creating friendly, personal conversations to create customer relationships to bring the customers back.
  • Throughout the day, they maintain a shoppable space by recovering the floor and fitting rooms, updating signs and pricing, and supporting any needed merchandise moves.
  • They always Finish Strong - sharing our Loyalty program benefits, making sure customers have all they need, and ending with a sincere thank-you, often walking the package around and using the customer’s name.
  • We believe service starts with each other - supporting one another with honesty, care, and collaboration so we can better serve our customers and communities.
  • And we know that excellence is a journey - we strive to improve every day, take pride in our work, achieve sales goals and learn from each other to deliver individual and store results.

Full-time colleagues are typically scheduled to work 30 or more hours per week, while part-time colleagues are typically scheduled 12-24 hours per week. All schedules contain weekend shifts as part of the requirements. Hours are dependent on business needs and colleague availability. Information regarding hours per week needed for benefit eligibility purposes can be found here.

Who You Are

  • Flexible availability, including days, evenings, weekends and holidays with regular, dependable attendance and punctuality
  • Must be able to:
    • Understand and communicate effectively with customers, co-workers, and supervisors
    • Read and understand employment policies and safety rules/procedures in English
  • Be comfortable communicating and collaborating with customers and colleagues
  • Responsible for acquiring new customers by opening credit accounts and sharing loyalty benefits
  • Meeting daily sales goal challenges
  • Enjoy meeting people, learning about them, and sharing information
  • Resourceful and eager to start a new venture and can adapt to changing priorities; you can work on your own but are great with team dynamics
  • You can handle electronic devices with no problem
  • At least 2 years of selling or customer experience preferred

Essential Physical Requirements You Will Perform

  • This position requires talking, lifting, constant moving, standing, and reaching with arms and hands
  • Standing for at least two consecutive hours, lifting at least 25lbs., stooping, kneeling, crouching, and climbing ladders, reaching, including above eye level
  • Requires close vision, color vision, depth perception, and focus adjustment
  • Frequent use of computers and other technology, necessary to perform job functions, including handheld equipment, cash register and ability to process register transactions

What We Can Offer You

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.

Some additional benefits we offer include:

  • Merchandise discounts
  • Performance-based incentives
  • Annual merit review
  • Employee Assistance Program with mental health counseling and legal/financial advice

Access the full menu of benefits offerings here.

About Us

This is a great time to join Macy’s! Whether you’re helping a customer find the perfect gift, streamlining operations in one of our distribution centers, enhancing our online shopping experience, buying in-style and on-trend merchandise to outfit our customers, or designing a balloon for the Thanksgiving Day Parade, we offer unique opportunities to be part of some of the most memorable moments in people’s lives.

Join us and help write the next chapter in our story - Apply Today!

title: Part-Time Online Course Facilitator: AI Strategy and Organizational Change
description:
Department Summary

eCornell delivers expertly crafted online certificate programs designed by Cornell University faculty. Our facilitators play a central role in creating dynamic, engaging, and highly interactive learning experiences. We are committed to providing an exceptional student experience through live interactions, meaningful feedback, and authentic engagement.


The Opportunity

We are seeking experienced professionals to join our team as Course Facilitators in our AI Strategy and Organizational Change portfolio. Facilitators are not course authors or adjunct faculty but are vital to ensuring the effective delivery of content created by Cornell faculty.


In this role, you will complement our asynchronous course content by:


  • Leading engaging live sessions that engage students in discussion of AI strategy, AI-enabled business transformation, and the organizational change required to realize value from AI.
  • Providing personalized and constructive feedback (written and recorded video) on discussion boards, assignments, and multi-part applied course projects such as AI opportunity assessments, workflow redesigns, business model innovations, venture derisking plans, and AI transformation strategies.
  • Coaching learners to connect AI capabilities, frameworks, and case examples to the real-world opportunities and challenges in their own roles, teams, and organizations.
  • Fostering meaningful connections with students in a highly interactive online environment.

To be considered for this position, please include a cover letter with your application materials.

Cover letter instructions [IMPORTANT]

As part of the Course Facilitator position at eCornell, video interaction with students is a key component of the role. Facilitators are expected to engage with students through live video sessions and in response to project submissions. Video interactions allow facilitators to better engage with students, provide real-time feedback, and create an inclusive and personable learning experience.

As such, we encourage applicants to submit a video response to the question below using Loom. While submitting the video is optional, it is highly encouraged.

  • Answer the following question in a short video (3 minutes max):

What excites you most about facilitating at eCornell, and how would you bring that enthusiasm into your interactions with students?

  • Record your response using Loom (free service).
  • Copy and paste the video link into your cover letter.

Program-Specific Focus


Facilitators will support AI Strategy and Organizational Change certificate programs, to help business leaders understand what AI can and cannot do, identify where it creates value, and lead the organizational transformation required to capture that value.


The ideal candidate has 8+ years of professional experience in one or more of the following areas, with the ability to explain these concepts to working professionals:


  • Understanding AI and digital technology capabilities from a business perspective, including perceptive, generative, reasoning, and agentic AI; the core ideas behind them (machine learning, reinforcement learning, and pre-training); their strengths and limitations; and how AI compares with past general-purpose and "abundance" technologies.
  • Redesigning work and operations with AI, including assessing how work is currently done and identifying opportunities for automation, augmentation, and information enablement. Assessing how roles, skills, managerial scope and span, and organizational structures must change to build an AI-first organization and a digital builder culture.
  • Driving AI-powered growth and strategy, including rethinking business models (scope, timing, revenue models, intermediaries, operating models, and industry ecosystems), building defensible competitive advantage when AI is widely accessible, and evaluating resource dependencies and commoditization risks.
  • Derisking and delivering AI transformation, including the learn-it-all, discovery-driven mindset; decomposing and prioritizing venture risks; designing prototypes, pilots, and business experiments (e.g., A/B tests and difference-in-differences studies); selecting performance metrics and interpreting data-based evidence; prioritizing a portfolio of AI initiatives; making build vs. buy decisions; and leading change across people and systems.
  • Navigating the risks and responsibilities of AI, including technology "failure modes," ethical frameworks, data privacy, liability, consumer protection, intellectual property and copyright, and the evolving AI regulatory landscape, and recognizing when legal expertise is needed.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Engage Students: Lead dynamic live discussions that foster interaction and deepen understanding.
  • Provide Feedback: Deliver clear, constructive, and authentic feedback on student submissions, including recorded video responses.
  • Facilitate Effectively: Manage online discussions, respond promptly to student inquiries, and track student progress.
  • Commitment: Facilitate a minimum of 1-2 courses per month with consistent engagement and preparation.
  • Onboarding and Training: Complete an in-depth onboarding program, including shadowing live courses, participating in debrief sessions, and mastering the assigned certificate program.
  • Continuous Improvement: Engage in ongoing training and professional development to stay current with emerging learning methodologies, educational technologies, and best practices in online facilitation.

Required Qualifications:

  • Has 8+ years of relevant professional experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Brings substantial experience in business strategy, digital or AI transformation, innovation, management consulting, operations, or product management, or general management, including hands-on work identifying, evaluating, or implementing AI or digital technology initiatives (e.g., workflow redesign, automation, augmentation of knowledge work, or AI-enabled products, services, and business models).
  • Demonstrates a practical, business-level understanding of modern AI, including generative, reasoning, and agentic AI and their capabilities, limitations, and risks. Uses current AI tools fluently in their own work and keeps pace with new developments.
  • Has experience leading or advising on organizational change, including redesigning roles and teams, building workforce skills and AI literacy, and fostering an experimentation-oriented, "builder" culture.
  • Applies a discovery-driven, data-informed approach to decision-making, including defining metrics, designing pilots or experiments, and interpreting evidence.
  • Is familiar with the ethical, legal, and regulatory considerations surrounding AI in business, such as data privacy, intellectual property, liability, bias, and responsible AI governance
  • Possesses exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical and strategic concepts clearly to professionals with varied backgrounds using relevant industry examples.
  • Is comfortable facilitating live online discussions, providing timely and substantive feedback to busy professionals, and using technology for instruction.
  • Loom video submission with application

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Graduate degree (e.g., MBA or related field) preferred.
  • Brings 15+ years of progressive experience in business strategy, technology leadership, digital or AI transformation, innovation, or management consulting.
  • Has held senior leadership, strategy, product, innovation, or transformation roles in which they set AI or digital strategy, built AI initiative portfolios, made build vs. buy decisions, or launched AI-enabled products, services, or business models.
  • Has led cross-functional teams through technology-driven change and can share firsthand experience with stakeholder alignment, workforce and role redesign, failed and successful pilots, scaling challenges, and measuring business impact.
  • Has experience in AI governance, responsible AI, risk management, or working alongside legal and compliance teams on AI-related issues.
  • Experience teaching, coaching, or mentoring business professionals and executives.

**Sponsorship for employment visa is not available for this position**


What We Offer:

  • Comprehensive onboarding and training program to set you up for success.
  • Access to ongoing professional development resources and periodic training updates.
  • Opportunities to contribute to an exceptional online student experience.
  • A collaborative and supportive facilitator community.

Additional Information

  • This position is based in Ithaca, New York, however, the successful applicant may perform this role remotely anywhere within the United States.
  • The New York Convenience of employer guidelines require New York State individual tax reporting and withholdings for this position. Additional individual state income tax filings may also be required if working temporarily outside New York State.

Important Notes

  • eCornell will not store or download your video; it remains on your personal Loom account.
  • Video submissions are assessed solely based on communication, clarity, and engagement—not on personal characteristics unrelated to job performance.

We look forward to learning more about you!

  • Location: These positions are remote and open to candidates located anywhere within the U.S.
  • Employment Type: Casual, non-benefits-eligible positions.
  • Restrictions: No visa sponsorship or relocation assistance is available for these positions.

Join Us

If you’re an experienced semiconductor manufacturer and are passionate about helping professionals learn the theory and practices critical to the process, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and become an integral part of the Cornell team!

The Gorman Group is a forward-thinking, innovative forest products company with five divisions spanning the Interior of BC and Northern Washington State. We believe that our people are the foundation of our success, and we value the unique contributions of every employee. That’s why we offer competitive wages and—most importantly—safe and rewarding work environments.

We are looking for 4 Summer Students to join our Woodlands Department, 2 at Similkameen Forest Products in Princeton and 2 at Gorman Bros Lumber in West Kelowna for Summer 2027 (May–August). This role provides a mix of field and office experience and is a great opportunity to gain hands-on knowledge in harvesting, silviculture, road construction, and environmental management. title: Software Engineering Manager
description:
Hej Software Engineering Manager,

Do you want to furnish the future with innovative solutions?

With us, you can feel at home in your work while sharing that feeling with millions of people around the world. We encourage you to stand up for yourself and others, creating an environment where everyone feels welcome. We invite you to open new doors, discover new tech possibilities, embrace mistakes, and grow from them. As our Software Engineering Manager, you’ll have many opportunities to try things you’ve never done before.

Your new job

We’re looking for a Software Engineering Manager who wants to solve complex, real-world problems to make life at home simpler. Join us on our journey as we level up our technology to enhance everyday experiences. Your primary focus will be on leading a dedicated team, focused on creating solutions for IKEA product range development. You’ll oversee a specific domain and your team’s development, operations, and delivery, while setting strategic direction and managing both vendors and employees. You will report to a Software Engineering Area Manager. The impact of your work will touch homes and hearts around the world. On a typical day, you will:

  • Secure a competent and high-performing team.

  • Provide thought leadership and innovation to address business challenges.

  • Lead and support DevSecOps and an agile culture

  • Establish and implement common ways of working.

  • Collaborate with stakeholders, including governance, process, operations, shared service counterparts, suppliers, and other digital units.

  • Coach and guide the team with up-to-date technology expertise.

What we’d like you to bring to the table

The role as a Software Engineering Manager requires you to:

  • Have some form of technical background, ideally within software engineering or a related technical field, with enough understanding of software development to lead and manage engineers.

  • Proven experience in people management, including setting clear expectations, providing continuous feedback, and supporting individual performance and development.

  • Ability to build and develop high-performing engineering teams by creating an inclusive environment based on trust, collaboration, and accountability.

  • Experience in coaching and developing software engineers, supporting both their professional growth and long-term career development.

  • Ability to lead through change and create clarity and direction in a complex and evolving technology environment.

  • Experience in handling challenging people-related situations and addressing performance or team dynamics in a constructive and timely manner.

  • Ability to empower team members and delegate responsibility, enabling people to take ownership and make decisions.

  • Experience in workforce and competence planning, identifying current and future capability needs within the engineering team.

Be yourself, a Software Engineering Manager, and more!

Inter IKEA Group is the group of companies that connects IKEA franchisees with range development and suppliers and aligns the overall IKEA strategic direction. Every day, we strive to develop, produce and sell products and services that are affordable and accessible to everyone. With us, you contribute to building a democratic brand and workplace that has a positive impact on both the planet and people's lives.

This role is positioned in Core Business Range, Range Operations, Technology. You will belong to a domain within the Range Core area. Range Core supports key flows in managing the range offer as well as the capabilities needed to create physical products and their core information. Our mission is to simplify and enable product and information creation and maintenance through software.

Your health, wellbeing, and development matter most to us, and our benefits are designed with you in mind. As a co-worker and a person, you are an essential part of our down to earth, playful, and inclusive culture, collaborating with others across roles, departments, and even across the globe. In this curious and optimistic environment, you’ll find endless opportunities to grow. Make us the home of your career.

We welcome your application

Get ready to assemble something new! We look forward to receiving your application in english by 20th of November.

This position is based in Malmö. We believe that your presence with the team and working the majority of the time in the workplace is important.

Please also note that we only handle applications in English and no applications coming in by email. If you have any questions about the role or the recruitment process, feel free to connect with the Recruiter, vera.bendz1@inter.ikea.com.

At IKEA, we are looking for people who believe everyone deserves a seat at the table. You’re welcome no matter where you come from, what you believe, and what you look like. We don’t even care how you have furnished your home. We’re interested in you simply because you’re you. Even if your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. We believe that people’s different perspectives, backgrounds, and personalities make us better at understanding our customers dreams and needs.

If you have a special need that requires accommodation in the recruitment process, just let us know.

Executes assigned testing for Corporate technology and cybersecurity operational audits. Evaluates controls and supporting evidence, documents clear and supportable results, and raises exceptions and emerging risks to the Senior IT Auditor or Manager.

Essential functions

  • Perform assigned audit procedures, including walkthroughs, control assessments, population validation, sample selection, evidence inspection, reperformance, and follow-up testing.
  • Test controls in operational cybersecurity and data-risk areas, including IAM/PAM and Active Directory; network security and firewalls; cloud security architecture and WAF; Security Operations, incident response, and SIEM/XDR/SOAR; vulnerability management and CTI; data protection and privacy, including DLP, encryption, and key management; and application security and Secure SDLC.
  • Inspect and test technical and architecture evidence, including configurations, access records, scan results, change records, logs, encryption, certificates, and documented exceptions in the assigned specialty, such as IAM/PAM, Active Directory, firewalls and network security, cloud/WAF, SIEM/XDR/SOAR, DLP, key management, or vulnerability controls.
  • For audits involving cloud environments, consult relevant cloud-provider security guidance to inform walkthroughs and testing. Consider recommendations for areas such as network security, access, segmentation, logging, and secure connectivity, alongside company policies, standards, and audit criteria.
  • Evaluate whether evidence is complete, reliable, relevant to the control, and consistent with the control objective. Identify gaps or contradictions and raise them promptly.
  • Document procedures, evidence reviewed, sample details, results, exceptions, and conclusions in organized, traceable workpapers.
  • Participate in walkthroughs and client discussions; explain evidence requests and testing questions clearly and follow up on outstanding items.
  • Analyze exceptions and support the assessment of their cause, impact, extent, and potential compensating controls.
  • Support issue development, report preparation, issue validation, and examination support materials.
  • Use audit tools and data analysis techniques where appropriate to validate populations, identify anomalies, or improve testing coverage.
  • Incorporate review comments and maintain audit files in line with Internal Audit quality standards.

Required qualifications

  • At least 3 years of relevant experience in IT audit, cybersecurity audit, technology risk, or related control testing, including at least 2 years directly performing IT or cybersecurity operational audits.
  • Hands-on operational audit testing in at least one target profile: (1) IAM/PAM, including CyberArk, Active Directory, or firewall/network controls; or (2) cloud security/WAF, SIEM/XDR/SOAR, DLP, encryption/key management, or vulnerability evidence. Experience limited to general ITGC testing is insufficient. Comparable tools are acceptable.
  • Working knowledge of risk-based audit testing, evidence evaluation, sampling, workpaper documentation, and communicating exceptions.
  • Familiarity with official security guidance for Microsoft Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud, including Azure network security best practices, the AWS Well-Architected Security Pillar, and Google Cloud Well-Architected security guidance; able to apply relevant guidance during audit testing.
  • Ability to manage assigned testing, meet deadlines, and raise questions or concerns promptly.
  • Strong analytical, written, and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain evidence needs to technical and nontechnical stakeholders.

Preferred experience

  • Experience testing controls in multiple technology or cybersecurity audit areas, especially Vulnerability Management, Network Security, Security Operations, Data Protection, Offensive Security, Application Security, Cloud Service Management, or Secure SDLC.
  • Banking or financial-services experience; exposure to GLBA, Interagency Guidelines, SWIFT CSP, PCI DSS, OWASP, CIS Benchmarks, NIST CSF, or NIST SP 800-series guidance.
  • Hands-on exposure to cloud environments or cloud security controls.
  • CISA or another relevant certification, or active progress toward one.
  • Relevant IT or cybersecurity coursework, professional training, or hands-on experience.
  • Familiarity with AuditBoard, Power BI, ServiceNow, Jira, or SailPoint.

  • Timely and meticulous attention to verbal and written communication.

  • Attentiveness to professionalism in appearance and action.

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT

Join a collaborative marketing team where you’ll play an important role in supporting the growth of Goldenwest Credit Union and its multiple brands. This position offers a variety of projects, from branch openings and community events to promotions and retail marketing initiatives. You’ll work with teams throughout the organization to support consistent and effective marketing initiatives across our branch network.

Location, Schedule Availability & Salary Information

  • 5025 Adams Avenue, Ogden, UT 84403

Position Summary

The Market & Branch Growth Specialist supports market and branch growth initiatives across Goldenwest Credit Union’s multiple brands by coordinating and executing marketing materials, events, branch promotions, and retail communications. This position collaborates with internal teams and external vendors to ensure accurate, consistent, and timely delivery of marketing initiatives across all brands and branch locations.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Market Growth Strategy Execution: Coordinate the implementation and oversee the execution of approved market growth initiatives, including messaging, marketing materials, events, and lead capture activities.

Partner with appropriate internal teams to maintain accuracy, brand consistency, and required approvals.
  • Vendor Coordination: Work with external vendors to source and order promotional merchandise and event materials, ensuring quality, accuracy, and timely delivery.
  • Inventory Management: Maintain promotional merchandise and marketing material inventories across all brands, including tracking quantities, coordinating fulfillment, and replenishing supplies.
  • Cross-Department Coordination: Communicate project timelines, requirements, and status updates to Marketing, branch teams, internal departments, Compliance, and other stakeholders to support timely execution.

Experience, Education & Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Public Relations, or a related field.
  • Strong project coordination and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple assignments and competing deadlines.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to build productive relationships across departments and with vendors.
  • Familiarity with event planning, logistics, and coordination.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively.
  • Ability to travel to branch locations and events as needed.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite; experience with marketing software or customer relationship management (CRM) tools is a plus.

title: Product Management Manager
description:
Company description

We are on a journey to transform our digital capabilities, bringing core business processes, people, data, and technology together—enabling IKEA to become an even better home furnishing retailer in the future. This journey requires passionate people who embrace change, dare to question, and want to make a difference. If that sounds like you, come and join us. Together, we can achieve great things.

You will report to the Operations Development Manager and be part of leading and develop how we operate IKEA across process, capability and product management. Together, we set a common direction and create the conditions for strong digital product management across Inter IKEA, enabling digital products to deliver business value in a consistent, effective and scalable way.

We believe that your presence with the team and working the majority of the time in the workplace is important.


Job description

As Product Management Manager, you will lead the digital product management capability across Inter IKEA. This means helping people, processes, data and technology work together in a simple, consistent and scalable way. You will enable the implementation of the digital product management framework across operations organizations in core businesses and Operations management, while helping teams create value through strong ways of working.

You will play an important part in connecting people and capabilities across the value chain. By setting direction, building common methods and making them easy to use, you will help strengthen digital product management and support better and faster business outcomes for the many people.

On a typical working day, you will:

  • Lead and develop product management across Inter IKEA through cross-functional alignment and collaboration across the value chain.
  • Secure efficient and common ways of working through clear frameworks, methods, roles, competence development and performance measurements.
  • Update ways of working and methods, and make them accessible through the common framework for the Operating model.
  • Connect with related capabilities and networks to make sure ways of working are aligned and fit for purpose in different contexts.
  • Lead the competence hub within Operations Management
  • Coordinate and collaborate across connected capabilities and core businesses to manage dependencies and create value together.

Qualification

The role as Product Management Manager requires you to bring strong experience in digital product management, together with the ability to lead through others, create alignment and make the complex simple.

We believe you have:

  • Deep knowledge and experience in digital product management, including working with agile methodologies.
  • Proven leadership experience from leading digital development teams in close collaboration with the business.
  • Experience of working with competence development for product management, agile coaching or agile delivery.
  • Strong communication, collaboration and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships across functions and organisations.
  • Experience of defining frameworks, methods, standards and practices, and driving adoption in a large and complex organisation.
  • A values-led leadership approach, with the ability to engage, empower and develop people and teams.
  • Experience with Product management frameworks and ways of working
  • An understanding of how Business Process Management, Business Capabilities, and Product Management work together to shape and continuously improve how IKEA operates.
  • Experience of working with competence development for product management, agile coaching or agile delivery.

It’s a plus if you also bring:

  • A strong desire to collaborate and be better together.
  • Energy for both the big picture and the details.
  • Curiosity and a learning mindset, with a drive to simplify and improve.
  • The confidence to take the lead while inviting contributions and shared ownership.
  • Persistence, a positive attitude and the ability to create clarity in an uncertain environment.
  • You are motivated by being better together, simplifying ways of working and helping others grow. You enjoy transforming the big picture into something understandable and useful, and you are energised by creating impact through people, teams and networks.

More Information

We look forward to receiving your application by 20th of November at the latest. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible. If you have any questions about the role or the recruitment process, or if you have a special need that requires accommodation in the recruitment process, feel free to contact the Recruiter Jas Garcha (jas.garcha@inter.ikea.com).

We always recruit based on values, competence, potential and diversity. Once competence requirements are met, we will first consider impacted co-workers employed in Inter IKEA Systems Service AB, Inter IKEA Technology Services AB and Inter IKEA Systems BV and secondly impacted co-workers at Inter IKEA Group

title: Business Process Owner (Remote)
description:
Who We Are

Join a team that puts its People First! Since 1889, First American (NYSE: FAF) has held an unwavering belief in its people. They are passionate about what they do, and we are equally passionate about fostering an environment where all feel welcome, supported, and empowered to be innovative and reach their full potential. Our inclusive, people-first culture has earned our company numerous accolades, including being named to the Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For® list for eleven consecutive years. We have also earned awards as a best place to work for women, diversity and LGBTQ+ employees, and have been included on more than 50 regional best places to work lists. First American will always strive to be a great place to work, for all. For more information, please visit www.careers.firstam.com.

What We Do

The Business Process Owner is responsible for continuously optimizing and modernizing operational workflows across the full title insurance lifecycle, from order opening through post-closing and policy issuance. This role applies a data-driven, first-principles approach to simplify, standardize, and improve processes, while owning specific process domains and driving them toward scalable, automated solutions. Working closely with cross-functional teams, the analyst translates operational needs into efficient, compliant workflows that balance automation and human input. By leveraging production data, embedding regulatory requirements, and supporting enterprise-wide adoption, the role ensures consistent, measurable improvements and helps institutionalize best practices across geographies and business segments.

HOW YOU’LL CONTRIBUTE

  • Own the analysis and optimization of defined process domains within the title insurance lifecycle, applying a first-principles mindset to challenge legacy workflows and drive toward simpler, more scalable, and outcome-driven solutions.
  • Partner with functional area teams and cross-functional stakeholders to reimagine and streamline workflows across the entire transactional lifecycle.
  • Translate operational needs into scalable, digital-first solutions by collaborating closely with technology and product teams to define automation, system enhancements, and integrations that amplify human performance.
  • Leverage production data and root cause analysis to diagnose issues, measure performance, and continuously refine processes—embracing adaptability and iteration as core to delivering sustained impact.
  • Develop, maintain, and govern standardized process documentation (e.g., SOPs, swim lanes, process narratives) to ensure consistency, scalability, compliance, and sustained adoption across the organization.
  • Embed compliance and regulatory requirements into all process design, balancing automation, human amplification, and governance to ensure solutions are both innovative and durable.
  • Serve as a process domain expert across business units, divisions, and segments—driving consistency and optimization as workflows are scaled, onboarded, and operationalized.
  • Partner with learning, product, and strategy teams to support the successful rollout and institutionalization of optimized processes across geographies and business segments.
  • Other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

Required Education, Experience, Certification/Licensure

  • 3+ years of experience in the functional area
  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration or related field preferred.

Knowledge, SKILLS, and Abilities (KSAs)

  • Deep and detailed understanding of functional area operations and processes.
  • Demonstrated experience in process analysis, workflow design, and leading process improvement initiatives.
  • Experience working with title production systems (e.g., Ignite, FAST, SoftPro, ResWare, RamQuest, Qualia, or similar platforms).
  • Strong analytical, communication, and process documentation skills, with the ability to translate complex workflows into clear, actionable insights.
  • Ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
  • Proficiency with process mapping and data tools (e.g., Visio, Lucid chart, Excel, and data visualization platforms).
  • Demonstrated digital mindset with a high degree of adaptability—comfortable challenging legacy processes, embracing change, and leveraging technology to reimagine how work gets done.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in title insurance and escrow industry, with direct exposure to the full transaction lifecycle.
  • Experience supporting multi-state, regional, or national title and escrow operations.
  • Experience driving process automation and workflow optimization within title and escrow environments.
  • Familiarity with Lean, Six Sigma, or other continuous improvement methodologies (certification preferred).
  • Experience in the design, configuration, or enhancement of title production systems (e.g., ResWare, SoftPro, or similar platforms).

** Note that the following statements only apply to candidates who will be working from an unincorporated area within Los Angeles County. **
First American will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws (e.g., the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act). First American intends to conduct a review of an applicant’s criminal history in connection with a conditional offer. First American reasonably believes that a criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following material job duties for this position potentially resulting in the withdrawal of the conditional offer of employment: handling of confidential, proprietary or trade secret information belonging to First American or its customers, administrating or facilitating financial transactions, and the ability to meet customer-imposed criminal history requirements.

What We Offer

By choice, we don’t simply accept individuality – we embrace it, we support it, and we thrive on it! Our People First culture is inclusive for all employees - not just because it's the right thing to do, but because it's the key to our success. We are proud to foster an authentic and inclusive workplace For All. You are free and encouraged to bring your entire, unique self to work. First American is an equal opportunity employer in every sense of the term.

Based on eligibility, First American offers a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, 401k, PTO/paid sick leave and other great benefits like an employee stock purchase plan.

Pay Range: $85,000.00 - $113,300.00 Annually

title: Beauty Brand Expert - Lancome, Town East - Full Time
description:
Be Part of an Amazing Story

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

Job Overview

As a Beauty Brand Expert at Macy’s, you are the go-to authority for your assigned brand, responsible for driving sales, elevating the customer experience, and leading with passion, expertise, and style. You serve as both a product educator and beauty enthusiast - creating personalized routines, demonstrating new trends, and helping customers look and feel their best.

In this role, you’ll inspire teamwork, coach fellow Beauty Advisors, and lead by example through exceptional service and product knowledge. You’ll foster customer loyalty, build relationships through clienteling, and execute brand strategies, events, and training in collaboration with store leadership and vendor partners. With a deep understanding of your brand and strong business acumen, you’ll analyze sales data, identify opportunities, and deliver results in a fast-paced, goal-driven environment.

How Our Beauty Brand Expert Leaders Spend Their Day…

  • Every day starts with a positive example. As a Beauty Brand Expert Leader, you come in energized and ready to inspire your team - wearing your name badge with pride, greeting colleagues with genuine warmth, and ensuring your counter is polished, organized, and fully prepared to welcome customers. You set the tone by reviewing daily sales goals, staying informed on new launches, top-performing products, and current beauty trends - so you're equipped to lead with confidence, support your team, and deliver exceptional service to every customer.
  • On the floor, you lead through action - welcoming customers with genuine hospitality, making eye contact, and starting friendly, personal conversations that build lasting relationships.
  • You help maintain a shoppable space by ensuring testers are clean and well-stocked, signage and pricing are current, and displays reflect brand standards. You lead by example, jumping in to support merchandising updates and keeping the space visually appealing and welcoming throughout the day.
  • You help the team Finish Strong - by reminding them to share Loyalty benefits, making sure customers leave with everything they need, and ending each interaction with a sincere thank-you, often using the customer’s name and adding a personal touch.
  • You know that service starts with each other. You model collaboration, honesty, and care - supporting your peers so the whole team can better serve our customers and communities.
  • And we know that excellence is a journey - we strive to improve every day, take pride in our work, achieve sales goals and learn from each other to deliver individual and store results.

Full-time colleagues are typically scheduled to work 30 or more hours per week, while part-time colleagues are typically scheduled 12-24 hours per week. Hours are dependent on business needs and colleague availability. Information regarding hours per week needed for benefit eligibility purposes can be found here.

Who You Are and What You Will Do

  • Deliver exceptional customer service through personalized consultations and expert product knowledge
  • Build lasting relationships with clients and drive client development through outreach and follow-up
  • Review and analyze business performance of daily, weekly, monthly, seasonal, and annual sales results and implement strategies to grow business and improve results
  • Plan and execute in-store and vendor-led events to drive traffic and engagement
  • Maintain brand standards through proper merchandising, hygiene, and stock replenishment
  • Collaborate with vendors, personal stylists, and store leadership to optimize outcomes
  • Resolve customer concerns in a professional and customer-first manner
  • Stay informed on new launches, best-sellers, and beauty trends to support team education
  • Manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment with strong attention to detail
  • Demonstrate sound judgment, and a passion for the beauty industry
  • Responsible for acquiring new customers by opening credit accounts and sharing loyalty benefits
  • 3–5 years of relevant retail, beauty, or leadership experience preferred
  • Flexible availability, including days, evenings, weekends and holidays with regular, dependable attendance and punctuality
  • Must be able to:
    • Understand and communicate effectively with customers, co-workers, and supervisors
    • Read and understand employment policies and safety rules/procedures in English

Essential Physical Requirements You Will Perform

  • This position requires talking, lifting, constant moving, standing, and reaching with arms and hands
  • Standing for at least two consecutive hours, lifting at least 25lbs., stooping, kneeling, crouching, and climbing ladders, reaching, including above eye level
  • Requires close vision, color vision, depth perception, and focus adjustment
  • Frequent use of computers and other technology, necessary to perform job functions, including handheld equipment, cash register and ability to process register transactions

What We Can Offer You

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.

Some additional benefits we offer include:

  • Merchandise discounts
  • Performance-based incentives
  • Annual merit review
  • Employee Assistance Program with mental health counseling and legal/financial advice

Access the full menu of benefits offerings here.

About Us

This is a great time to join Macy’s! Whether you’re helping a customer find the perfect gift, streamlining operations in one of our distribution centers, enhancing our online shopping experience, buying in-style and on-trend merchandise to outfit our customers, or designing a balloon for the Thanksgiving Day Parade, we offer unique opportunities to be part of some of the most memorable moments in people’s lives.

Join us and help write the next chapter in our story - Apply Today!

title: Technician (Toppen Shopping Centre)
description:
Company description

The IKEA vision is to create a better everyday life for the many people. We do this by offering a wide range of well-designed, functional home furnishing products at prices so low that as many people as possible can afford them. We operate in Singapore, Malaysia and Thailand – and have an ambitious expansion plan to bring a little bit of Sweden to new markets in the region. We are part of the Ikano Group of companies and the only IKEA franchisee owned by the Kamprad family that founded IKEA.

We also develop, own and operate Shopping Centres that are anchored by IKEA and create walkable communities by including residential, office and other types of real estate in our development plans.

We work towards making sustainability a natural part of our everyday work. We are active in our communities, driving and supporting social initiatives that benefit children, women and the environment.


Job description

Job Description

The Facilities Management function ensures that buildings, technical systems, infrastructure, and operational environments are maintained safely, efficiently, sustainably, and in alignment with Ikano Retail operational standards and business objectives. The function supports operational continuity, maintenance planning, compliance, technical reliability, and customer experience through effective operational execution and technical support.

The Technician supports the effective delivery of daily maintenance and building operations within the Shopping Centre. The role contributes to maintaining safe, functional, and reliable facilities through preventive and corrective maintenance, equipment servicing, inspections, troubleshooting, and operational support activities to ensure operational continuity and a positive environment for customers, tenants, co-workers, and stakeholders.

Your assignment

Daily Operations & Maintenance

  • Perform servicing, repair, and maintenance of all mechanical, electrical, plumbing (MEP) systems and building infrastructure.
  • Conduct routine inspections and operational checks on ACMV systems, lighting systems, electrical panels, plumbing systems, LPG systems, water systems, building structures, façades, and aesthetic components.
  • Take utility meter readings including electricity, Gas and water consumption and record operational data for reporting purposes.
  • Support smooth operation and maintenance of building facilities, technical systems, and operational assets.
  • Assist in maintaining operational areas, technical rooms, and facilities infrastructure in safe and functional condition.

Preventive Maintenance & Troubleshooting

  • Execute preventive maintenance activities according to approved schedules and CMMS requirements including Urbanise systems.
  • Maintain operating logs, maintenance checklists, equipment records, and technical documentation accurately.
  • Troubleshoot technical systems including Fire Protection Systems, ELV Systems, PA Systems, CCTV, Intrusion Alarm Systems, UPS Systems, and Public Display Panels.
  • Escalate abnormalities, technical faults, operational risks, and unresolved maintenance issues to the Technician Team Lead or Facilities Management team.
  • Support emergency response activities and after-hours operational breakdown support where required.
  • Support corrective maintenance works, technical troubleshooting, and operational recovery activities to minimise operational disruptions.

Safety & Compliance

  • Support Safety & Security operations by maintaining building safety equipment in accordance with SecCheck standards and operational requirements.
  • Ensure all operational and maintenance activities are carried out safely and with minimal disruption to customers, tenants, co-workers, and operations.
  • Follow Permit to Work (PTW) procedures, operational guidelines, and safety requirements during maintenance and contractor activities.
  • Support internal audits, operational inspections, authority visits, and compliance reviews where required.
  • Ensure operational tasks comply with statutory requirements, operational standards, SOPs, and governance expectations.

Contractor Support & Coordination

  • Assist in monitoring contractors and service providers during scheduled maintenance and ad-hoc operational works.
  • Check quality, completion status, and workmanship of vendor activities and report deficiencies or operational concerns where required.
  • Coordinate with other departments during operational activities, repairs, events, and tenant support works.
  • Support contractor operational coordination and ensure work activities comply with operational and safety requirements.

General Support

  • Assist in updating equipment inventories, PM checklists, maintenance documentation, and technical drawing records.
  • Support operational improvements, maintenance activities, and operational assignments as directed by the Technician Team Lead or Facilities Management team.
  • Perform ad-hoc operational duties, technical support tasks, and maintenance assignments required by the business.

Qualification
  • Certificate in Electrical, Mechanical, Building Technology, or equivalent technical trade qualification.
  • Relevant trade certification such as Wireman or certification in Low Voltage Systems such as A0, A1, and A4 is preferred.
  • Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience in building maintenance, Facilities Management, or technical operations environments.
  • Good understanding of M&E systems, architectural drawings, plumbing systems, and technical infrastructure.
  • Familiar with CMMS systems, operational reporting, and maintenance documentation practices.
  • Basic reporting capability and ability to document completed works and operational updates clearly.
  • Experience in retail property management or facilities operations environments is preferred.
  • Good understanding of operational safety requirements, PTW procedures, and maintenance practices.
  • Proficient in Bahasa Malaysia and English both written and spoken.

More Information
