title: Manager, Manufacturing Operations
description:
Virgin Galactic is seeking an experienced and inspired Manager of Manufacturing Operations to lead manufacturing execution for our Rocket Motor production. Guided by our values, “Safety above All”, we proactively manage the risks inherent in human spaceflight through our daily actions in the design and assembly efforts.

This position will lead a multi-tier team, including associate managers, supervisors, leads, and technicians across multiple facilities/departments. This role will own the manufacturing build plan and execution strategy for our spaceflight systems/vehicles and will serve as Manufacturing’s voice to Program Leadership. You will partner closely with multiple Program Managers, schedulers, engineering, and other cross-functional departments to deliver programs safely, on time, and on budget while ensuring compliance with company’s policies, procedures and overall objectives.

Work Schedule: Thursday - Monday Day Schedule

As an exempt position, the Manufacturing Manager may be required to work outside of the technician shift schedule

Responsibilities

  • Planning, scheduling, coordinating, and executing all aspects of our manufacturing operation, along with budget, headcount, and labor deployment for the program
  • Create manufacturing build plans, and own their development, implementation, and maintenance for the program
  • Lead project planning, recovery plans, and build execution for project and program deliverables
  • Provide a clear plan of action for the Program and translate program strategy into actionable priorities for the Manufacturing team
  • Work with multiple Program Managers to deliver the project safely, on time, and on budget
  • Report program status, risk assessment, and other metrics to Program Leadership to support short-term and long-term goals
  • Communicate scheduling setbacks; develop and implement recovery plans with engineering/manufacturing to provide conflict resolution
  • Oversee efforts between all manufacturing and engineering functions to properly support the build schedule by identifying tooling, materials, resources, planning, and product definition to ensure a seamless transition from paper to reality
  • Partner with production control and planning to assure assembly flow is supported by all functions and to implement agile response strategies for rapid project adjustments
  • Influence technical projects, technicians, and inter-departmental functions to achieve goals and solve problems
  • Help manage budgets for programs and departments within the Manufacturing organization
  • Own labor deployment, headcount management, and development of annual labor resource forecasts in alignment with the build schedule and in collaboration with program stakeholders to support the Integrated Master Schedule (IMS)
  • Define technical training requirements and ensure team members are trained and qualified to perform their work
  • Drive Root Cause and Corrective Action (RCCA) efforts and Lean/continuous improvement initiatives to improve safety, quality, schedule, and cost
  • Drive safety behavior and enforce Foreign Object Debris (FOD) awareness/prevention; ensure adherence to regulatory protocols and rules
  • Coaches, trains, and transfers expertise to the team to drive projects to completion Ensure work deliverables are prioritized based on production schedule, organizational goals, and metrics, with clearly defined roles and accountability

Required Skills and Experience

  • Relevant education, such as a Bachelor’s degree in engineering, business, or a related field; trade school or Associate’s degree with equivalent technical work experience will be considered
  • Minimum of eight years’ experience in an aerospace or equivalent high-reliability field, with five years of leading supervisors, leads, and multidisciplinary technical teams
  • Demonstrated leadership experience with production, assembly, and systems integration teams, ideally in an aerospace and/or manufacturing environment
  • Experience in Manufacturing Leadership, Manufacturing Program/Project Management, or Production Planning
  • Strong production line knowledge, including component assembly from subassembly through final top-level assembly
  • Proven budget management experience for manufacturing programs or departments
  • Experience with labor deployment and headcount management to meet production schedules
  • Experience defining technical training requirements and building team qualification/certification plans
  • Demonstrated experience driving Root Cause and Corrective Action (RCCA) to closure
  • Extensive experience and/or training in Lean manufacturing principles and leading process improvement workshops or Kaizen events
  • Strong understanding of engineering and manufacturing functions and of the schedule, quality, and budget relationship
  • Working knowledge of configuration management practices and quality management processes
  • Ability to read and interpret drawings, blueprints, and/or models on paper or digital
  • Demonstrated computer and analytical skills, including proficiency in MS Excel, manufacturing software, scheduling tools, or related programs and dashboards
  • Experience in a start-up organization or a highly unique cultural environment
  • Some experience within an external customer-facing role
  • Familiar with the use of personal protective equipment (PPE)

Physical and/or Additional Requirements

  • As an exempt position, the Manufacturing Manager may be required to work outside of the technician shift schedule
  • Must be able to stand for extended periods – 9 hours min
  • Must be able to stoop, bend, crawl, and being able to maneuver in tight spaces
  • Physically able to handle items weighing up to 40lbs (unassisted)

title: Store Crew
description:
7-Eleven is an iconic family of brands with over 86,000 locations, surpassing every retailer in the world. We revolutionize convenience, restaurants and fuel through cutting edge innovation — working hard to be the customer's first choice. 7-Eleven empowers our employees to 'activate awesome' and make a meaningful impact in their stores and communities every day. If you're ready to grow, lead and make a difference, come join our team and help shape the future of convenience.

Retail Sales Associate

Crew positions are entry level opportunities with schedules to fit your life. As one would expect, cash handling, fuel transactions, cleaning, and stocking are part of the role with some foodservice positions specifically tasked with food prep and foodservice safety. What you might not expect is the camaraderie of the store team and fun interactions with customers. Cashier, customer service, retail or foodservice experience is great, but not required. If you have a positive attitude, our training programs will prepare you to excel in the role.

What we bring:

  • Schedule flexibility! We have opportunities with schedules to fit your life.

Our benefits include:

title: Escrow Assistant
description:
Who We Are

Join a team that puts its People First! First American's Direct division provides comprehensive title insurance protection and professional settlement services for real estate purchases, refinances and equity loans. Since 1889, First American (NYSE: FAF) has held an unwavering belief in its people. They are passionate about what they do, and we are equally passionate about fostering an environment where all feel welcome, supported, and empowered to be innovative and reach their full potential. By choice, we don’t simply accept individuality – we embrace it, we support it, and we thrive on it! Our People First culture is inclusive for all employees - not just because it's the right thing to do, but because it's the key to our success. We are proud to foster an authentic and inclusive workplace For All. You are free and encouraged to bring your entire, unique self to work. First American is an equal opportunity employer in every sense of the term.

title: Manager in Training
description:
Grand Canyon BU - Region 01 - Market 02: 2400 S Arizona Ave, Yuma, Arizona 85364

Availability - Shift/Days

Flexible Availability



Minimum Qualifications

The minimum qualifications for a Store Manager are:

  • High School diploma or GED preferred.
  • Experience in retail sales preferred.
  • Experience to perform the essential duties, responsibilities and working in the conditions described below.
  • Ability to supervise and train for the use of equipment, tools and materials listed in the Customer Service Representative (CSR) and Assistant Site Manager (ASM) job description.
  • Ability to supervise and manage the functions listed in the CSR and ASM job description.
  • Ability to use computer, or acquire those skills necessary to use a computer at the site, which includes analysis of reports, inventory control, cash control, counseling notices, etc.
  • A valid driver’s license and adequate transportation to/from bank and corporate management meetings.
  • Ability to communicate (orally and in writing) in English.
  • Perform other duties as assigned or delegated by his/her supervisor.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES, RESPONSIBILITIES AND SKILLS

Leadership and Management

  • Recruit, hire and train positive, enthusiastic employees, ensuring excellent customer service.
  • Develop, manage and assign tasks appropriately to ensure the site is clean, adequately stocked, organize and well kept based on Company standards.
  • Maintain a professional and supportive image among subordinates and supervisor.
  • Schedule employees within Company guidelines to maximize customer service and maintain site image.
  • Implement non-discriminatory related management skills while hiring, training, counseling, motivating and separating employees.

Site Relationships

  • Develop positive and professional relationships with all suppliers.
  • Promote excellent service and resolve customer complaints in a timely, professional manner.
  • Promote and ensure a safe, positive public image within the neighboring community.

Training and Development

  • Prepare on-going and timely performance appraisals in writing for all employees, providing proper performance based feedback.
  • Train all employees ensuring that customer service, site image and marketing execution meet Company standards.
  • Train all employees on safety procedures and promote safety awareness.

Communication

  • Develop ways and means to ensure that all employees receive proper communication in a timely manner.
  • Establish periodic on-going communication meetings with all site employees and the Market Manager.

Organizing and Planning

  • Evaluate and develop specific action plans to address the needs of the site in order to reach the desired objectives.
  • Organize and maintain all site files and manuals.
  • Manage and supervise store employees to ensure that all required and requested reports due are completed accurately and timely.
  • Manage and supervise store employees to ensure that all merchandise is stocked, attractively displayed and priced correctly.
  • Ensure that all required employment related posters and signs are in a place that is easily accessible to all employees.

Financial

  • Analyze daily sales and expense information and take appropriate action to maximize sales and net profits.
  • Budget and forecast P&L lines, as well as understand and manage merchandise margins.
  • Safeguard and account for all money received and disbursed.
  • Perform all other financial analysis necessary to maximize sales and net profits.

Working Conditions

  • Performs approximately all work indoors but will be required to work outside in order to clean parking lots, gas pumps, take out garbage, etc.
  • Be exposed to occasional cold temperature extremes while supervising or managing store employees performing occasional work in a walk-in cooler and/or freezer.
  • Be exposed to occasional noise.
  • Work with a minimum of direction and supervision.
  • At all times work as an effective manager, supervisor and leader.

THE ABOVE STATEMENTS REFLECT THE GENERAL QUALIFICATIONS/DUTIES AND/OR RESPONSIBILITIES NECESSARY TO IDENTIFY THE JOB AND ARE NOT NECESSARILY INTENDED TO SET FORTH ALL OF THE SPECIFIC REQUIREMENTS OF THE JOB.

title: Financial Counselor
description:
At Mahaska Health the Financial Counselor serves as a liaison between patients and available financial resources, assisting individuals in understanding and addressing their financial obligations for healthcare services. This role provides guidance on funding options and payment solutions, including but not limited to Medicaid, Financial Assistant and other financial assistance resources. The Financial Counselor works collaboratively with patients, families, healthcare providers, and external agencies to facilitate access to appropriate financial support, promote informed financial decision-making, and help minimize barriers to receiving care.

Essential functions include but are not limited to,

Patient Financial Counseling & Collections

  • Assist patients with completing applications for presumptive Medicaid, Financials Assistance, and other available programs.
  • Review daily inpatient, emergency room, surgical, and outpatient admissions identified as self-pay or underinsured to determine eligibility for financial assistance or governmental programs.
  • Conduct financial interviews with patients and/or family members to obtain payment, establish payment arrangements, or determine eligibility for assistance programs.
  • Process, monitor, and maintain payment plans, payroll deductions, and other payment arrangements in accordance with organizational guidelines.
  • Process Financial Assistance applications and submit recommendations for approval according to established procedures.
  • Generate and distribute patient notices, and financial assistance application materials according to departmental schedules.
  • Perform collection activities through phone, written correspondence, and other approved communication methods while maintaining excellent customer service standards.
  • Monitor accounts for delinquency and initiates appropriate follow-up actions in accordance with hospital policies.
  • Research and process account adjustments and refunds in compliance with organizational policies and procedures.
  • Assist with estate lien processes and documentation in accordance with applicable laws, regulations, and organizational procedures.
  • Advise self-paying patients of available community resources, public health services, and other programs that may assist with future healthcare needs.

Insurance Verification & Financial Clearance

  • Verify insurance eligibility, benefits, coverage limitations, deductibles, co-insurance, and other patient financial responsibilities.
  • Utilize payer websites and direct communication with insurance carriers to obtain eligibility and benefit information for scheduled or proposed services.
  • Calculate estimated patient responsibility and collect payments or establish payment arrangements in accordance with hospital policies.
  • Collaborate with Registration, Case Management, Utilization Review, and Revenue Cycle departments to address patient status changes and financial responsibility determinations.

Account Maintenance & Documentation

  • Maintain complete, accurate, and timely documentation of all account activities within designated financial and patient accounting systems.
  • Process account reminders, follow-up activities, and work queues within established departmental timeframes.
  • Run reports and perform account audits to identify and resolve registration, billing, and discharge discrepancies.
  • Ensure recurring patients are appropriately discharged within designated systems and investigate unresolved account statuses.
  • Monitor quality metrics and implement process improvements.

Bad Debt & Legal Recovery

  • Prepare and file documentation necessary for small claims proceedings and other approved collection activities.
  • Support bad debt recovery efforts through accurate account review, documentation, and follow-up in accordance with organizational policies and regulatory requirements.
  • Monitor reports and account status indicators to ensure timely resolution of outstanding balances and billing exceptions.
Job qualifications include but are not limited to,
  • High school diploma, GED, or equivalent required. Associate degree in Business, Healthcare Administration, Accounting, Finance, or a related field preferred.
  • Previous experience in healthcare registration, patient accounts, financial counseling, medical billing, collections, insurance verification, or revenue cycle operations preferred.
  • Knowledge of inpatient and outpatient hospital billing, insurance claim processing, reimbursement methodologies, and preferred governmental assistance programs.
  • Experience working with electronic health records (EHR), patient accounting systems, and standard office software applications preferred.
  • Proficient computer skills, including Microsoft Office applications and the ability to learn and effectively utilize hospital information systems.
  • Working knowledge of medical insurance plans, including Medicare, Medicaid, commercial insurance, managed care organizations, and patient financial responsibility requirements.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and adapt to changing workloads.
  • Ability to work independently while exercising sound judgment, discretion, and attention to detail.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to explain complex financial and insurance information in a clear and compassionate manner.
  • Strong customer service skills with the ability to establish rapport and maintain professionalism in sensitive or difficult situations.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills with the ability to identify appropriate financial solutions for patients.
  • Adhere to all confidentiality policies, including compliance with HIPAA and Mahaska Health training requirements.

title: Beauty Counter Manager - MAC, Galleria At Crystal Run - Full Time
description:
Be Part of an Amazing Story

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

Job Overview

As a Counter Manager, you will lead a dynamic team of Beauty Advisors while managing all aspects of a specific cosmetics brand. Your role blends leadership, creativity, and customer engagement—delivering genuine hospitality through personalized consultations, expert product application, and a deep understanding of each customer’s beauty and style preferences.

You’ll inspire teamwork to drive sales and elevate the customer experience by creating meaningful, long-lasting connections. With a strong focus on client development, you will cultivate a loyal customer base through outreach, follow-up, and consistent, personalized service.

In addition to meeting and exceeding sales goals, you’ll analyze business performance, execute vendor events and promotions, and partner with vendors and store leadership to grow the business. You'll also oversee stock presentation, hygiene standards, and team performance to ensure an exceptional and polished brand experience.

How Our Counter Managers Spend Their Day…

  • Every day starts with a positive example. As a Counter Manager, you come in energized and ready to inspire your team - wearing your name badge with pride, greeting colleagues with genuine warmth, and ensuring your counter is polished, organized, and fully prepared to welcome customers. You set the tone by reviewing daily sales goals, staying informed on new launches, top-performing products, and current beauty trends - so you're equipped to lead with confidence, support your team, and deliver exceptional service to every customer.
  • On the floor, you lead through action - welcoming customers with genuine hospitality, making eye contact, and starting friendly, personal conversations that build lasting relationships.
  • You help maintain a shoppable space by ensuring testers are clean and well-stocked, signage and pricing are current, and displays reflect brand standards. You lead by example, jumping in to support merchandising updates and keeping the space visually appealing and welcoming throughout the day.
  • You help the team Finish Strong - by coaching them to share Loyalty benefits, making sure customers leave with everything they need, and ending each interaction with a sincere thank-you, often using the customer’s name and adding a personal touch.
  • You know that service starts with each other. You model collaboration, honesty, and care - supporting your peers so the whole team can better serve our customers and communities.
  • And we know that excellence is a journey - we strive to improve every day, take pride in our work, achieve sales goals and learn from each other to deliver individual and store results.

Full-time colleagues are typically scheduled to work 30 or more hours per week, while part-time colleagues are typically scheduled 12-24 hours per week. Hours are dependent on business needs and colleague availability. Information regarding hours per week needed for benefit eligibility purposes can be found here.

Who You Are and What You Will Do

  • Deliver exceptional customer service through personalized consultations and expert product knowledge
  • Build lasting relationships with clients and drive client development through outreach and follow-up
  • Review and analyze business performance of daily, weekly, monthly, seasonal, and annual sales results and implement strategies to grow business and improve results
  • Plan and execute in-store and vendor-led events to drive traffic and engagement
  • Maintain brand standards through proper merchandising, hygiene, and stock replenishment
  • Responsible for acquiring new customers by opening credit accounts and sharing loyalty benefits
  • Collaborate with vendors, personal stylists, and store leadership to optimize outcomes
  • Resolve customer concerns in a professional and customer-first manner
  • Stay informed on new launches, best-sellers, and beauty trends to support team education
  • Manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment with strong attention to detail
  • Demonstrate flexibility, sound judgment, and a passion for the beauty industry
  • 3–5 years of relevant retail, beauty, or leadership experience preferred
  • Flexible availability, including days, evenings, weekends and holidays with regular, dependable attendance and punctuality
  • Must be able to:
    • Understand and communicate effectively with customers, co-workers, and supervisors
    • Read and understand employment policies and safety rules/procedures in English

Essential Physical Requirements You Will Perform

  • This position requires talking, lifting, constant moving, standing, and reaching with arms and hands.
  • Standing for at least two consecutive hours, lifting at least 25lbs., stooping, kneeling, crouching, and climbing ladders, reaching, including above eye level
  • Requires close vision, color vision, depth perception, and focus adjustment
  • Frequent use of computers and other technology, necessary to perform job functions, including handheld equipment, cash register and ability to process register transactions

What We Can Offer You

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.

Some additional benefits we offer include:

  • Merchandise discounts
  • Performance-based incentives
  • Annual merit review
  • Employee Assistance Program with mental health counseling and legal/financial advice

Access the full menu of benefits offerings here.

About Us

This is a great time to join Macy’s! Whether you’re helping a customer find the perfect gift, streamlining operations in one of our distribution centers, enhancing our online shopping experience, buying in-style and on-trend merchandise to outfit our customers, or designing a balloon for the Thanksgiving Day Parade, we offer unique opportunities to be part of some of the most memorable moments in people’s lives.

Join us and help write the next chapter in our story - Apply Today!

title: Technician Team Lead (Toppen Shopping Centre)
description:
Company description

The IKEA vision is to create a better everyday life for the many people. We do this by offering a wide range of well-designed, functional home furnishing products at prices so low that as many people as possible can afford them. We operate in Singapore, Malaysia and Thailand – and have an ambitious expansion plan to bring a little bit of Sweden to new markets in the region. We are part of the Ikano Group of companies and the only IKEA franchisee owned by the Kamprad family that founded IKEA.

We also develop, own and operate Shopping Centres that are anchored by IKEA and create walkable communities by including residential, office and other types of real estate in our development plans.

We work towards making sustainability a natural part of our everyday work. We are active in our communities, driving and supporting social initiatives that benefit children, women and the environment.


Job description

The Facilities Management function ensures that buildings, technical systems, infrastructure, and operational environments are maintained safely, efficiently, sustainably, and in alignment with Ikano Retail operational standards and business objectives. The function supports operational continuity, maintenance planning, compliance, technical reliability, and customer experience through effective operational execution and technical support.

The Technician Team Lead is responsible for supervising the daily operations and performance of the technician team to ensure all facilities systems and infrastructure within the Shopping Centre are functioning safely, efficiently, and reliably. The role supports operational excellence through maintenance coordination, technical supervision, vendor coordination, compliance support, and timely response to operational and technical issues while contributing to long-term maintenance planning and operational continuity.

Your assignment

Technical Operations & Team Supervision

  • Supervise the technician team in the maintenance, repair, and servicing of all MEP systems and building infrastructure including ACMV systems, electrical systems, plumbing, lighting, LPG systems, building structures, and aesthetic components.
  • Lead regular facilities inspections and ensure maintenance activities, inspections, and operational updates are properly recorded in CMMS/Urbanise systems.
  • Monitor technician team performance, assign daily maintenance activities, and ensure operational tasks are completed effectively and timely.
  • Ensure operational documentation, logbooks, asset records, spare part inventory records, maintenance reports, and checklists are maintained accurately and submitted timely.
  • Support team planning, operational coordination, knowledge sharing, and technical capability development within the technician team.
  • Guide and coach technicians to ensure operational consistency, technical competency, and compliance with safety and operational standards.

Preventive & Corrective Maintenance

  • Plan, coordinate, and monitor preventive maintenance works based on approved schedules and operational priorities.
  • Ensure maintenance execution for systems including BMS, Automatic Meter Reading Systems, Public Display Systems, Lighting Control Systems, Fire Protection Systems, CCTV, PA Systems, Security Alarms, and Emergency Buttons.
  • Troubleshoot recurring technical faults, operational failures, and maintenance issues and coordinate rectification activities with contractors or internal Chargeman where required.
  • Support execution of corrective maintenance, emergency repairs, operational troubleshooting, and technical rectification activities.
  • Monitor technical system performance and support operational reliability and maintenance effectiveness across facilities operations.

Service Provider Coordination

  • Coordinate and oversee contractors and service providers to ensure works are delivered according to approved scope of work, operational standards, service agreements, and safety requirements.
  • Support Facilities Management teams in reviewing contractor performance, operational quality, and on-site service delivery.
  • Conduct joint inspections and support onboarding, briefing, and coordination activities for contractors and service providers.
  • Ensure contractors comply with Permit to Work (PTW) procedures, operational guidelines, and safety protocols before commencement of works.

Compliance & Safety Support

  • Support Safety & Security operations by ensuring building safety systems and equipment are maintained in accordance with SecCheck standards and operational requirements.
  • Assist during authority inspections, internal audits, and compliance reviews by preparing operational documentation and supporting technical compliance activities.
  • Support operational compliance with statutory requirements, safety procedures, operational standards, and governance expectations.
  • Ensure operational activities are executed safely and in accordance with approved procedures and operational controls.

Other Responsibilities

  • Support Assistant Facilities Manager and Facilities Manager in operational planning, maintenance coordination, knowledge sharing, and staff development activities.
  • Support project handovers, operational upgrades, emergency response activities, and system improvement initiatives.
  • Perform ad-hoc operational assignments, technical projects, and maintenance support activities as assigned by management.

Qualification
  • Certificate or Diploma in Electrical, Mechanical, Building Services, or related technical disciplines.
  • Relevant trade certification such as Wireman, OB, or Building Technology is an advantage.
  • Minimum 5 years of working experience in facilities operations, property maintenance, or technical services with supervisory exposure.
  • Skilled in operating, maintaining, and troubleshooting building systems and technical controls.
  • Familiar with M&E, architectural, sanitary, and structural drawings.
  • Good understanding of CMMS systems, operational reporting, and compliance documentation.
  • Experience in retail property management or facilities operations environments is preferred.
  • Good understanding of operational safety requirements, PTW procedures, and contractor management practices.
  • Proficient in Bahasa Malaysia and English both written and spoken.
  • Computer literacy and operational reporting capability will be an added advantage.

More Information

Performance-Based Job Description: Powder Coater

Hours: Monday through Friday 7AM to 3PM

Pay Rate: $18.50 per hour!

Position: Powder Coater

Job Summary:

We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Powder Coater to join our team. The successful candidate will supplement our automated spray booth on an automated conveying line with a 5-stage wash process. Using Gema spray guns, the Powder Coater will apply powder coatings to aluminum extrusions, ensuring high-quality finishes. The role requires collaboration with a team of 7 to 15 operators to achieve daily production targets while maintaining strict adherence to safety and efficiency standards.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and Responsibilities:

  1. Powder Coating Application:
    • KPI: Ensure at least 98% uniform coverage with no more than 2% rework required.
    • Assist in the operation of the automated powder coating spray booth using Gema spray guns.
    • Manually touch up and coat areas missed by automated systems.
    • Monitor and control coating thickness, ensuring even coverage and high-quality finishes.
  2. Pre-Treatment and Preparation:
    • KPI: Complete pre-treatment processes with a 100% accuracy rate in accordance with company standards.
    • Assist in the 5-stage chemical wash process, including degrease, rinse, zirconium conversion coating, rinse, and sealant stages.
    • Prepare and properly hang aluminum extrusions on the conveyor line for optimal coating application.
  3. Quality Control:
    • KPI: Achieve a defect rate of less than 1% on finished products.
    • Inspect parts for surface defects and ensure they meet quality standards before and after coating.
    • Conduct routine checks and make necessary adjustments to Gema spray guns to maintain optimal performance.
    • Record and report any defects or issues promptly to prevent production delays.
  4. Maintenance and Safety:
    • KPI: Maintain zero incidents of safety violations and ensure equipment is operational with less than 1% downtime.
    • Perform regular maintenance and cleaning of spray guns and other equipment to prevent malfunctions.
    • Adhere to all safety protocols, including the proper use of PPE.
    • Maintain a clean and organized work area to ensure a safe working environment.
  5. Collaboration and Teamwork:
    • KPI: Demonstrate effective communication and coordination with team members, achieving 100% adherence to production schedules.
    • Work closely with the shift supervisor and team members to optimize workflow and meet daily production targets.
    • Provide support and guidance to new operators, fostering a collaborative and efficient work environment.

Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Performance Criteria: Minimum of 1 year of experience in powder coating or a related field preferred.
  • Familiarity with Gema spray guns and automated conveying systems.
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to perform precise and consistent work.
  • Basic mechanical skills and the ability to troubleshoot equipment issues.
  • Ability to lift and move heavy objects, and stand for extended periods.
  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills.

Working Conditions:

  • Full-time position with the potential for overtime.
  • Work environment involves exposure to chemicals, powder coatings, and machinery.
  • Requires the use of PPE such as masks, gloves, and protective eyewear at all times.

This performance-based job description outlines the expectations and standards for the Powder Coater role. Achieving these KPIs will ensure the delivery of high-quality products, a safe work environment, and efficient production processes.

title: Store Co-worker - Plan and Order Point Brasov
description:
Responsabilitățile tale

• Planificarea mobilierului în funcție de cerințele și nevoile clienților, utilizând sistemele de planificare specifice IKEA.
• Consilierea clienților și menținerea spațiului de prezentare la standardele IKEA, pentru a crea o experiență cât mai plăcută la cumpărături.
• Promovarea produselor și serviciilor IKEA.
• Participarea în cadrul programelor de pregătire în vederea însușirii modului de lucru și a detaliilor specifice produselor IKEA.
• Îndeplinirea în mod eficient a proceselor de bază și de asistență în zona de responsabilitate alocată, utilizând sistemele și instrumentele disponibile utile pentru asigurarea eficienței operațiunilor și a integrității datelor.
• Contribuirea la obținerea unei disponibilități optime a bunurilor prin executarea precisă și la timp a operațiunilor din domeniul de responsabilitate alocat din cadrul departamentului.
• Respectarea regulilor și cerințelor IKEA privind sănătatea, siguranța și securitatea în aria de responsabilitate și susținerea acțiunilor menite să prevină orice incident care ar putea implica colegii, clienții, echipamentele, clădirile sau produsele IKEA.
• Contribuirea la optimizarea operațiunilor zilnice ale departamentului în Fulfilment Operations, în zona de responsabilitate, lucrând într-un mod simplu, conștient de costuri, aplicând și împărtășind exemple bune.
• Folosirea casei de marcat pentru încasarea și returul produselor clienților.

CINE EȘTI

• Foarte bune abilități de comunicare și interacțiune cu clienții.
• Înclinații tehnice, interes și pasiune pentru decorarea locuințelor.
• Experiența de planificare mobilier poate fi un avantaj.
• Capacitatea de prioritizare și organizare, pentru a utiliza în mod eficient timpul de care dispui.
• Cunoștințe de limbă engleză - nivel mediu și abilități de operare PC - nivel mediu/avansat.
• Flexibilitate de a lucra în ture și în weekend-uri.
• Experiență relevantă în utilizarea echipamentelor tehnice din domeniul logistic.
• Apt/ă pentru manipularea de produse până la 25 kg, în activitatea zilnică.





De ce a lucra la IKEA înseamnă mult mai mult decât un loc de muncă?

• Îți vom oferi un salariu corect și atractiv și îți vom acorda compensații suplimentare dacă lucrezi în schimbul de noapte sau în weekend, te vom susține financiar cu o indemnizație pentru transport și masă și vei avea întotdeauna la dispoziție mâncare gătită (cu carne sau vegetariană) în restaurantul angajaților, precum și băuturi și gustări gratuite (cafea, sucuri, fructe).
• Știm că timpul tău liber este important, așa că, în fiecare an, vei primi un voucher de vacanță.
• Ai o cameră suplimentară pe care ai vrea s-o renovezi? În calitate de angajat IKEA, beneficiezi de discounturi la toate produsele noastre.
• Credem că fiecare dintre noi contribuie la îndeplinirea (și depășirea) obiectivelor noastre. Aceasta este ideea care stă la baza programului nostru unic de bonusuri pe bază de performanță: One IKEA Bonus. Acesta ne recompensează pentru că dezvoltăm afacerea noastră – împreună!
• Sănătatea și starea ta de bine sunt priorități maxime pentru noi, așa că îți oferim un abonament medical privat și asigurare de viață. Suntem conștienți că toată lumea are ocazional nevoie de ajutor cu provocările vieții și cerințele zilnice. Îți oferim asistență non-stop din partea unor experți externi dacă ai nevoie de ajutor legat de probleme profesionale, personale și emoționale sau dacă ai nevoie de consiliere juridică ori financiară.
• Există multe oportunități de creștere, așa că îți vom oferi o gamă largă de cursuri de training online prin intermediul platformei noastre de învățare; iar dacă dorești să-ți schimbi cariera sau postul, nu va fi nevoie să părăsești compania: avem multe oportunități și exemple de angajați care și-au schimbat postul, locația sau chiar țara.

title: Graphic Design Specialist II
description:
Who you are

We are looking for a Graphic Design Specialist II who with his/her passion and creativity could take the IKEA brand in the heart and mind of the many people and increase the interest of many people in Home Furnishing in the local market.

About you

• You have the ability to combine and identify commercial, aesthetic and practical skills.
• You are confident in approaching and communicating clearly with different people in various situations.
• You have the ability to work together with others in a team.
• You have a practical hands-on approach to work.
• You have the ability to prioritize and organize own work to make the most efficient use of available time and meet agreed deadlines.
• You have the ability to visualize and present ideas.
• You are proficient and have an extensive experience in using production tools and graphic design software like InDesign and Illustrator.
• You have an education in graphic communication design, media and typography.
• You have the ability to prioritize and organize own work in order to make the most efficient use of available time.
• Your desire is to seek out opportunities that improve the way we work, thereby minimizing financial and environmental costs.
• You have basic communication skills in English and good verbal & written skills in Romanian language.

Your responsibilities

You will:

• Use graphic communication competence to strengthen the uniqueness and consistency of the IKEA identity in store communication by applying the principles of IKEA visual and verbal identity.
• Actively contribute to the department action plan with initiatives that will grow the business and support long-term profitability and execute the agreed plans in close co-operation with other functions.
• Plan, implement and evaluate store communication to ensure that it conveys the benefits if the IKEA Concept as well as completes and enhances range presentation by using proven solutions, best practices, guidelines and national directions.
• Actively contribute to developing, implementing and evaluating store communication strategies that support a convenient shopping experience by using knowledge about life at home and shopping behavior in the local market.
• Respect routines and responsibilities work together with Communication & Interior Design team and other functions in the store, act quickly to exploit commercial opportunities and understand the impact of your actions on the financial results.
• Secure visual balance and consistency, quality and simplicity, cost-efficiency and sustainability in producing and implementing store communication.
• Keep visitors in mind and minimize disruption when working on the shop floor.



Where others see home furnishing products, we see smart solutions to create a better everyday life. With a great deal of passion, imagination and brainstorming we turn colours, textiles and furniture into inspiring environments that excite, engage and convince IKEA visitors that they can do it too!





Why working in IKEA is so much more than a job?

We're a company that cares about the lives of our co-workers. It's important for us that you feel respected, acknowledged, and included. No matter what position we hold at IKEA, you'll have a variety of benefits. Here are just some of them:

• We will provide you a fair and attractive salary, support you financially with transportation and meal allowance and you will always have cooked meals (meat or veggie) in our co-worker restaurant and free refreshments (coffee, juices, fruit)
• We know that your free time is important so you will get each year a holiday voucher.
• Is there an additional room you would like to refurbish? As an IKEA co-worker, you have discounts on all our products.
• We believe that each of us contributes to reaching (and exceeding) our goals. That's the idea behind our unique, performance-driven bonus program: One IKEA Bonus. It rewards us for improving our business – together!
• Your health and well-being are our top priorities, so we provide you private medical subscription and life insurance We understand that everyone needs help with life challenges and daily demands from time to time. We offer you 24/7 support from external experts if needed with work, personal and emotional issues, or you need legal or financial advice.
• There are many opportunities to grow so we will arrange you with a wide offer of online training using our learning platform and if you want to change your career or position, you don't need to change company to change jobs – we have many opportunities and examples of our co-workers changing position, location or even country.

title: Master Scheduler
description:
Do you enjoy balancing customer demand, production capacity, and material availability to drive operational success?


Are you passionate about turning complex forecasts and supply chain requirements into executable production plans that deliver results?


The Master Scheduler is responsible for planning and scheduling the materials and production activities required to execute the business. This role partners closely with Sales, Commercial, Regional Operations, AMO, Manufacturing, and Supply Chain teams to translate demand forecasts, sales orders, and planned orders into actionable production schedules. The Master Scheduler plays a critical role in ensuring customer commitments are met while optimizing inventory, capacity, and manufacturing performance.


Partner with the Best

As a Master Scheduler, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining production plans that align customer demand with manufacturing capabilities and supply chain constraints. You will collaborate across functions to drive operational execution, improve schedule performance, and support business growth.


As the Master Scheduler, you will be responsible for:

  • Owning and maintaining the Master Production Schedule (MPS), balancing customer demand, material availability, production capacity, and operational priorities.
  • Leading production scheduling and backlog reviews to ensure on-time delivery and revenue commitments are achieved.
  • Analyzing demand, inventory, capacity, and material constraints to develop executable production plans.
  • Managing order prioritization, pull-ins, pushouts, and recovery plans to support critical customer commitments.
  • Monitoring schedule attainment, capacity utilization, work-in-process (WIP), and production performance while driving corrective actions as needed.
  • Partnering with Procurement, Manufacturing, Engineering, and Customer Service teams to mitigate shortages and resolve supply chain risks.
  • Validating MRP recommendations and maintaining planning parameters including lead times, safety stock levels, and work center capacities.
  • Supporting Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) activities through demand analysis, capacity planning, and production forecasting.
  • Developing reports and dashboards to track backlog, on-time delivery, inventory health, and manufacturing performance metrics.
  • Leading continuous improvement initiatives focused on increasing throughput, reducing lead times, and improving schedule adherence.

Fuel Your Passion

To be successful in this role you will:

  • Have a Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Operations, Engineering, or a related field from an accredited university or college.
  • Have a minimum of 5 years of experience in production planning, scheduling, supply chain, manufacturing operations, or a related field.
  • Have a strong understanding of Master Production Scheduling (MPS), Material Requirements Planning (MRP), Capacity Planning, and Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP).
  • Have experience utilizing ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, or similar enterprise planning platforms.
  • Have advanced analytical and reporting skills with tools such as Microsoft Excel, Power BI, or equivalent applications.
  • Have experience working within manufacturing, operations, and supply chain environments.
  • Demonstrate the ability to influence cross-functional teams and drive execution in a fast-paced operational environment.

Desired Characteristics

  • APICS/ASCM certifications such as CPIM or CSCP.
  • Strong oral and written communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze data, identify trends, and make sound business decisions.
  • Proven problem-solving and root cause analysis capabilities.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Experience leading continuous improvement initiatives and driving operational excellence.
  • Ability to build collaborative relationships across manufacturing, supply chain, commercial, and operations teams.
  • Strong attention to detail with a focus on customer satisfaction and business performance.

Work in a Way That Works for You

This position is an on-site role supporting manufacturing and supply chain operations. The Master Scheduler will work closely with production, procurement, engineering, customer service, and leadership teams to ensure effective planning, scheduling, and execution of business requirements. Regular interaction with manufacturing operations and operational stakeholders is required to support business objectives and customer commitments.


Working with Us

Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all of our people are developed, engaged, and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, train and reward talent, and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.

description:
CAS uses intuitive technology, unparalleled scientific content and unmatched human expertise to help companies create groundbreaking innovations that benefit the world. As the scientific information solutions division of the American Chemical Society, CAS manages the largest curated reservoir of scientific knowledge, and for 119 years, has helped innovators mine, assess and apply that information to keep businesses thriving. description:
Do you enjoy creating innovative solutions?

Would you like to play a leading role in chemical research and development?

Join our team and innovate with technology

Our Drilling & Completions Fluids Technology Development team creates solutions for facilitating optimum well construction. Our family of industry leading water-based and emulsion-based drilling and completion fluid technologies provide advanced performance driving safe and cost-effective operations. Through our innovations, our customers can drill and complete wells faster and more efficiently and realize higher production rates at lowest cost per barrel.

Partner with the best

As an R&D Engineer, you will be proving and validating the viability of technologies from their conception to first deployment through the application of scientific and engineering methodologies. You will take ownership of research and development projects for novel solutions to existing and new challenges in Oil and Gas and Geothermal operations. You will demonstrate through testing and analysis the performance and implementation potential of a concept.

As an R&D Engineer, you will be responsible for:

  • Conducting research and experiments to analyze data and test hypotheses to gain an understanding of products and processes
  • Applying sophisticated scientific understanding to research or development problems to provide inventive solutions toward new development efforts
  • Collaborating with research and manufacturing functions throughout product development cycle projects to ensure successful project delivery
  • Communicating research results to stakeholders through reports and presentations
  • Managing projects to achieve targeted results and delivery date
  • Creating and protecting intellectual property for our company to ensure ownership of our products and designs
  • Working in R&D, product modification, product scale-up, and chemistry troubleshooting


Fuel your passion


To be successful in this role you will have:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Chemistry, Engineering, or other scientific/petroleum degree or 5 years’ experience working in the Drilling & Completions Fluids industry
  • 2+ years’ experience testing and formulating Drilling & Completion Fluids
  • 2+ years’ experience working in a lab
  • A strong foundation of lab skills and safety
  • Ability to develop new test methods for in-depth product characterization
  • A solid understanding of chemical structure-property relationships
  • Excellent problem-solving, process improvement, and analytical skills
  • A basic understanding of time and project management
  • Ability to regularly lift and stand for an extended amount of time/frequently lifting and/or moving up to 25 pounds
  • Excellent written and verbal English skills and the ability to work in a collaborative team environment

title: Sr. Engineer, Avionics SW Test
description:
As a Sr. Engineer, Avionics Software Test, you will be an integral part of the software verification team that will be responsible for developing, integrating, and executing software verification across multiple LRUs on new carrier vehicles and spaceships. Guided by our values, “Safety Above All”, we proactively manage the risks inherent in human spaceflight through our daily actions. You will have extensive experience verifying safety critical software utilizing automated test frameworks. In addition, you will take part in avionics software and systems integration and help with troubleshooting and contribute in future updates and modifications.

Responsibilities

  • Design and document verification strategies and steps for verifying software requirements
  • Translate verification steps into automated scripts to run on automated test bench
  • Participate and contribute in creating automated test benches
  • Collaborate with a multi-disciplinary team in designing, verifying and validating a complex hardware/software systems
  • Continuously practice safety behavior and Foreign Object Debris (FOD) awareness/prevention; adhere to regulatory protocols and rules
  • Maintain focus on timeliness and execution of tasks and deliverables every day
  • Work collaboratively to achieve goals and/or complete assigned tasks
  • Adhere to set directions and guidelines from team leader to support collaboration across teams to complete projects

Required Skills and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical field
  • 8+ years of experience with requirements-based, safety-critical real-time software verification in aerospace or similar field
  • Experience with requirements-based software testing for avionics
  • Experience with Vectorcast or similar unit testing tools
  • Experience developing a regression testing framework with Python
  • Strong safety forward thinking, practice good housekeeping, tool control, recognizing the importance of properly handling hazardous materials and chemicals
  • Familiar with the use of personal protective equipment (PPE)
  • Demonstrate willingness to adjust thinking and behavior
  • Ability to communicate in a manner that is timely, respectful, and open to other ideas
